Review extracted values against the papers

Source: R/review_app.R
review_values.Rd

Opens a Shiny app for verifying data points one at a time. For each value it shows a plain-language reading of the numbers (e.g. "median (IQR) = 4.2 (3.1 to 5.5) pg/mL"), the group and method it belongs to, flags from check_values(), where it was reported (source, source_page, source_quote) and, if available, the full text opened at that page.

Usage

review_values(
  path = ".",
  fulltext_dir = NULL,
  reviewer = NULL,
  launch.browser = TRUE
)

review_values_app(path = ".", fulltext_dir = NULL, reviewer = NULL)

Arguments

path

Project root.

fulltext_dir

Optional folder with full texts named <study_id>.pdf or <sanitize_id(doi)>.pdf (or .html/.txt). Defaults to <path>/fulltext if it exists.

reviewer

Reviewer name or initials (can also be set in the app).

launch.browser

Passed to shiny::runApp().

Value

Runs the app. review_values_app() returns the app object.

Details

Actions (with keyboard shortcuts):

  • Verify (V): the value matches the paper. If you edited any field, the button saves the correction first and records what changed.

  • Reject (R): the value is wrong or should not be used; it is left out of load_metawoRld() by default.

  • Next / previous (N / P, or the arrow keys).

  • Map variable: add an unknown variable name as a synonym in _rules.yml, or define it as a new variable.

Decisions are stored in data/<study>/verification.csv with reviewer, time and a fingerprint of the values; if the values change later (e.g. re-extraction), the data point is marked "changed" and comes back into the queue.
